title: 5 Ways To Improve Your 2-Step | Beginning Breaking Tutorial
description:
Today we will be learning a step that I used to call the 1-2-3- Step which allows us to travel around the floor with our footwork. Eventually I learned the more formal name for the step which is the "Pass De Bouree." The only difference is that this is done on the floor with your footwork. Hope you enjoy!
